tool.name: PrepareDataFolder
tool.displayname: 0. Set Up and Audit Data Folder

param.name: data_parent
param.displayname: Data folder location (the HLZ data folder is created inside it)
param.dialogReference:
The folder in which the HLZ data folder is (or will be) created.

Requires: An existing local folder with a short path, such as C:\GIS. Not OneDrive, Dropbox or another synced folder. Choosing an existing data folder itself also works.

Effect: The data folder is <this folder>\<Data folder name>.

Example: C:\GIS
param.pythonReference:
The folder in which the HLZ data folder is (or will be) created.

Requires: An existing local folder with a short path, such as C:\GIS. Not OneDrive, Dropbox or another synced folder. Choosing an existing data folder itself also works.

Effect: The data folder is <this folder>\<Data folder name>.

Example: C:\GIS

param.name: data_name
param.dialogReference:
Name of the data folder.

Requires: Letters, digits, '_' or '-'. Default HLZ_DATA.

Effect: Ignored when the location chosen above is already a data folder.
param.pythonReference:
Name of the data folder.

Requires: Letters, digits, '_' or '-'. Default HLZ_DATA.

param.name: create_layout
param.displayname: Create missing folders (nothing is moved or deleted)
param.dialogReference:
Creates the standard sub-folders, a README in each and the hlz_data_root.json marker.

Requires: Nothing.

Effect: Only ADDS what is missing. Nothing is ever moved, renamed, overwritten or deleted. Untick to audit only.

param.name: audit_aircraft
param.displayname: Aircraft for the AOI margin check
param.dialogReference:
The aircraft whose approach range sets how far the DTM must extend beyond the AOI.

Requires: Any aircraft in the list (generic medium by default).

Effect: Only changes the AOI margin check (approach range + touchdown point + ring).

tool.summary: Creates a standard HLZ data folder (HLZ_DATA) with a sub-folder for every input - DTM, DSM, hydrology, exclusions, AOI, search centres, obstacles, profiles, runs - and audits what is in it: what is missing, what is wrong, how to fix it, and which files the analysis will use. Nothing is moved or deleted.
tool.usage:
Run it once to create the folder, copy your data into the sub-folders, then run it again to audit.

The audit report is written to 09_Audit\HLZ_Data_Audit_latest.html (also .txt and .json).

FAIL items stop the analysis; WARN items lower the quality of the results; INFO items are for your information.

Then choose the data folder in the first field of '1. Analyze HLZ Suitability': empty fields are filled from it.
